content_of_post_to_comment: I’m sick and tired of society telling people discipline is hard, these fucking podcasters and hustle grind culture ppl spreading this idea that “yeah bro just fucking grind bro hate your life and just be disciplined all the time and live in a box and suffer bro” stfu, this is the exact reason why people aren’t discipline, cause of nocebo (a type of placebo), you hear discipline is hard, suddenly your brain anticipates the task is actually hard and associates all this negative emotion to the task and then you don’t do it cause you are anxious, suddenly you wanna go to the gym and you are having a psychological warfare with yourself, jesus christ man just put your fucking shoes on and go, The more you think about a task, the more you won’t do it, the more emotion you attach to a task, doesn’t matter if its positive or negative, you won’t do it. The best advice I can give anybody is just stop thinking about it and do it, it’s fucking simple, it’s not rocket science, and then people are gonna say shit like oh yeah if you are sick just get better, No I’m not the saying that, The point is to stop associating so much emotions to your tasks, Be emotionless about them, Emotionless minimalistic discipline works, You don’t have to think you are Jeff Bezos or the next billionaire or visualize success or whatever to do your task, and you also don’t have to think you are going against your emotions and its going to be hard and have that psychological war with yourself, associate no emotion at all, neither positive nor negative, Just control your hands and legs, pick the fucking notebook or put your shoes on or whatever and just start doing the thing, make a timetable, thats what i do everyday, make a 50/50 timetable that’s my thing, 50% of the time I’ll have fun, and 50% of the time I’ll be productive, If i have 6 hours of free time in my day, i’ll play video games or watch youtube or whatever for 3 hours and ill be productive for 3 hours and get my work done, its simple, it’s not rocket science, Its not even discipline, Discipline is a made up propaganda by society, it’s not that hard and its not that deep, just do the fucking thing, set a timetable, give yourself some leisure time and then some productive time and keep switching, first 2 hours ill play video games, then the next 2 hours ill learn something, then next 2 hours fun time and repeat. Its not be discipline or productive 24/7, u won’t do it then, pick a system where you get some sort of productivity out of your day, for me 50/50 works, I can’t do 60% work, 40% fun, or 70% work 30% fun, nope, 50/50 is where it’s at for me, and hey its better than not being productive at all. Cause before this, I’ve struggled with discipline my entire fucking life and never knew it was this easy.
comment: The 50/50 timetable idea is actually something a lot of people overlook. I think the useful part isn't that everyone needs the exact same split, but that removing the guilt around rest makes starting easier. Sometimes people turn productivity into a moral test, and that pressure becomes the thing they avoid.
